text:
Jo (PM): heads-up 100 we need a tight decision on GA scope for Console Observability. customers want quick wins but infra warns of cost risk. propose we lock musts and push fancy stuff to v1.1.
Amit (Eng): agree. MUST: 1) 3 dashboard templates + one-click apply, 2) hot-path tracing hooks with visible sampling rates, 3) per-route estimated cost badge, 4) error drilldown linking to traces. NICE: long retention, adaptive anomaly detection, full billing export.
Clara (SRE): ops: require throttles + fallback to summary traces. recommend hosted default retention=7d, dedicated=30d. SLOs: dashboard p50 <180ms, p95 <600ms; trace join success >96% on mirror.
Ben (Design): gallery: ship 3 templates. will include small sample-size & sampling-rate indicators and a tiny tooltip explaining "estimated" vs actual invoice. can deliver mocks in 4 days.
Rocio (CS): customers request top-10 routes spend widget and CSV export. CSV is high-impact for finance teams.
Marta (Security): residency & audit log of export config needed. exports must be admin-restricted. also KMS notes for Dedicated.
Jo (PM): rollout: internal canary -> 3-customer beta (opt-in) -> GA. beta acceptance: 3 customers signoff, perf SLOs met, cost-estimate median error <7%, export audit + residency doc.
Amit (Eng): sampling config draft:
```
tracing.default_sample_rate=0.03
tracing.hot_path_override=0.9
retention.hosted_days=7
retention.dedicated_days=30
throttle.burst=5000
throttle.fallback=summary_traces
```
Amit (Eng): note: consider adaptive sampling for hot-paths later; initial rollout keep simple to reduce risk.
Clara (SRE): ops-bot: deploy-queue 7 waiting (avg 2m). extend canary by 24h this week.
deploy-bot: mirror-job started for beta at 2024-10-01T03:15:00Z targeting 5% traffic.
Rocio (CS): I'll draft beta invite and feedback checklist: dashboard usefulness, sampling transparency, cost accuracy, RCA confidence.
Ben (Design): UX microcopy: add "throttled" and "sampled" badges with hover explanation. will mock.
Marta (Security): export sink changes must write audit entries and require admin role. I'll add checklist for docs.
Jo (PM): action items: Amit -> sampling + throttle behavior doc by Fri. Ben -> gallery mocks + badges by Thu. Clara -> SLO doc + rollback criteria by Mon. Marta -> residency + export audit checklist by Wed. Rocio -> beta list + invite copy by Thu. I'll consolidate roadmap and create tickets.
Amit (Eng): one more: we'll surface "estimated $/route" as a toggleable badge; show sample size & methodology when toggled.
Jo (PM): good. closing thread 1  follow-up meeting after docs land. :rocket:
